purpose: Evaluate fixed AUV-style CALF-Wrapper operating modes over every eligible checkpoint before choosing the publication subset.

checkpoint_policy.rule: Include every saved checkpoint at or before the environment's declared training horizon for every available training seed.
checkpoint_policy.selection_timing: Select the three publication stages only after the complete checkpoint table exists; retain and archive the complete table.

calf.relaxprob_factor_rule: Solve target_NAB = mean_{t=0}^{T-1}(relaxprob_init * relaxprob_factor^t) separately for each environment horizon T.

evaluation.fallback_rule: Evaluate fallback once per environment because it is checkpoint-independent.
evaluation.artifact_policy: Upload raw per-trial metrics and a JSON summary as a single MLflow batch; verify every file remotely by size and SHA-256.

publication_selection.constraint: Do not delete or suppress checkpoint-mode results when selecting the compact publication view.
publication_selection.validation_note: Any data-driven choice of a checkpoint or mode must be confirmed in a separately labelled held-out evaluation before it is reported as a final estimate.
